import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nyc_dohmh_leading_causes_of_death.csv')
cond = (
    (df['Year'] == 2013) &
    (df['Sex'].isin(['M', 'Male'])) &
    (df['Race Ethnicity'] == 'Hispanic') &
    (df['Leading Cause'].str.contains('HIV|Immunodeficiency', case=False))
)
result = int(df[cond]['Deaths'].iloc[0])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nyc_dohmh_leading_causes_of_death.csv')
cond_base = (
    (df['Year'] == 2019) &
    (df['Sex'].isin(['M', 'Male'])) &
    (df['Race Ethnicity'].isin(['Non-Hispanic White', 'White Non-Hispanic']))
)
heart = int(df[cond_base & df['Leading Cause'].str.contains('Heart', case=False)]['Deaths'].iloc[0])
diabetes = int(df[cond_base & df['Leading Cause'].str.contains('Diabetes', case=False)]['Deaths'].iloc[0])
result = heart - diabetes

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nyc_dohmh_leading_causes_of_death.csv')
r1 = float(df[(df['Year'] == 2021) & (df['Leading Cause'].str.contains('Covid', case=False)) & (df['Sex'].isin(['M', 'Male'])) & (df['Race Ethnicity'] == 'Hispanic')]['Age Adjusted Death Rate'].iloc[0])
r2 = float(df[(df['Year'] == 2021) & (df['Leading Cause'].str.contains('Covid', case=False)) & (df['Sex'].isin(['F', 'Female'])) & (df['Race Ethnicity'].isin(['Black Non-Hispanic', 'Non-Hispanic Black']))]['Age Adjusted Death Rate'].iloc[0])
result = 'yes' if r1 > r2 else 'no'
